results.explanation: Actual x86-64 hardware/OS/features/topology/affinity/load/memory and perf counter probe retained; unavailable counters are not zero.
Protocol fixed before measurements: 3 warmups, 12 paired tuning, 20 paired held-out, fixed randomization, 2000-bootstrap uncertainty, 5% improvement/regression thresholds.
Seven actual AOT+ORC workloads retain build/link/load/profile/native-call/full-invocation/total costs, raw timestamped controls and reproducible analysis; final implementation hashes unchanged.
Exact source and main/generic/guard object hashes are prevalidated against reference and AOT output. Forced native guard failure executes generic path with equal observable results.

Fresh subprocesses reload committed synthetic-fixture observations, revalidate exact native objects and actually dispatch optimized; absent state restores generic. Synthetic fixture establishes policy influence only. Separate real-measurement passive→active CLI reload passed and correctly retained generic.
All seven controls execute matching workloads/fresh contexts with exact semantic equality; 140 recorded control batches per workload. Frozen profile read-only, active updates after dispatch.

No cost-inclusive benefit. Every workload restores generic. Later samples use doubled batches of the same programs; no unseen-program generalization. Concurrent compilation/conformance is a retained limitation.

Normal and optimized policy suites pass 12 tests each including restart, corruption, stale host/software/workload/artifact, version, invalid costs, state removal and interrupted temporary-file writes. Profile input/work/update costs bounded; single-writer ownership explicit. Checksum-valid unpaired counts or histories inconsistent with min(generation,32) reject; lawful capped paired histories load.
